packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of stable (1.0 and later) versions merge on their own when CI on JDK 17 and 27 is green
0.x versions are never automerged: a 0.x minor may break (lmdbjava 0.9.3 changed its JPMS module name and broke the build)

The Descoped libraries stay on 2.x until rawdata-client 3.0.0 is on Maven Central: rawdata 2.x and 3.x need different majors of service-provider-api under one JPMS module name, so they move together in one pull request (see .claude/CLAUDE.md). Lift this rule in that pull request.
commons-jexl3 stays on 3.2.1 until the expression sandbox is introduced: 3.3 restricts permissions by default, which changes what specifications may evaluate. Lift this rule in that pull request.
JDK versions in the workflows are deliberate: CI builds on JDK 17 and 27, `respond` on 17. They are changed by hand, never bumped.
Maven bumps through the wrapper: Renovate does not update distributionSha256Sum, so CI fails until it is set by hand (see .claude/CLAUDE.md, Maven Wrapper)
prBodyNotes: Update `distributionSha256Sum` in `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties` to the SHA-256 of the new `apache-maven-<version>-bin.zip`, after checking the zip against Maven's published `.sha512`.
